formula: -rolling_skewness(close returns, 60, min_periods=10) * normalized_ATR(14), EWM smoothed over 20 days
code:
def factor_tail_risk_skewness_vol_stress_smoothed(df):
    """Left-tail fragility: negative 60-day return skewness scaled by normalized ATR, EWM smoothed."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    skew = ret.rolling(60, min_periods=10).skew()
    atr = pd.Series(
        talib.ATR(
            df_copy["high"].to_numpy(),
            df_copy["low"].to_numpy(),
            df_copy["close"].to_numpy(),
            timeperiod=14,
        ),
        index=df_copy.index,
    )
    norm_atr = atr / df_copy["close"].replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stress = -skew * norm_atr
    factor = stress.ewm(span=20, min_periods=10).mean()
    df_copy["factor_tail_risk_skewness_vol_stress_smoothed"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_tail_risk_skewness_vol_stress_smoothed"]
description: Preserves the parent's core left-tail fragility mechanism: negative return skewness identifies fatter left tails, and normalized ATR scales that fragility by the current volatility regime. The mutation removes the liquidity impact weight (intraday range per dollar volume z-score compressed by tanh) because it adds unnecessary complexity and potential overfitting without evidence of improving tail-risk ordering. The child retains a single core economic mechanism, improving interpretability and focusing on the parent strength target of RankIC and ICIR robustness after industry-size neutralization.
